style_summary: Dense playful hand-drawn megatype: irregular interlocking colored letters, bold black contours, sparse doodles and neutral paper.

environment_variables.SUBJECT: the interlocked hand-drawn two-word headline itself; the letters are the illustration, no separate figure
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: oversized letters pressing into each other and stretching across the two tiers
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: no product; the small hand-written oval badge acts as the only prop-like element
environment_variables.LOCATION: a flat neutral warm-paper poster field with no scene
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: sparse unfilled black line doodles scattered in the margins
environment_variables.MAIN_TEXT: the two-word headline built from WORD_ONE and WORD_TWO
environment_variables.SECONDARY_TEXT: the hollow-outline invitation line and the casual handwritten footer
environment_variables.WARDROBE_STYLE: not applicable; express theme through letter colors and doodle motifs instead of clothing

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] Giant individually hand-drawn uppercase letters form a dense interlocking two-word mass, with exaggerated unequal widths, stretched stems, irregular baselines and slight overlaps.
[CORE] Every major letter has a thick imperfect black marker contour and one vivid flat color; counters remain open and words readable.

[CORE] Very light cool gray paper (#e4e7e5 approximate) surrounds the lettering, with delicate evenly distributed paper grain; the identical paper color fills all letter counters and hollow text. No bright pure white or yellow aging.
[CORE] Small loose black contour doodles sit around the letter mass; typography is the subject, never a backdrop to a large character.
[CORE] Main filled lettering is followed by a smaller hollow-outline uppercase invitation and a casual handwritten footer.
[CORE] Flat marker-and-print rendering, with sparse local dry-ink scuffs inside selected colored letters and mostly clean neutral paper.
[FLEX] Select four to six high-purity colors per theme and reorder them across letters; retain warm/cool alternation and strong neighboring color separation.
[FLEX] Doodles change by theme but remain a few small unfilled marks, not stickers or detailed illustrations.
[FLEX] Portrait uses a rising two-tier letter mass; landscape uses a broad staggered letter mass with footer below, independently drawing each letter to fit.
source_content_to_avoid: BUNNIES CLUB name and exact letter layout
Source rabbit mascot and its distinctive face
Creator watermark, username and Chinese source tag

visual_deconstruction.dominance: Letters occupy most of the upper and middle poster, stretching into neighboring rows.
visual_deconstruction.rhythm: Alternating tall/narrow and wide/bulging glyphs, diagonal terminals, squeezed negative spaces; doodles are secondary.

composition.portrait: Upper three quarters contain two interpenetrating tiers; lower zone holds outline invitation and handwritten footer.
composition.landscape: Broad low two-tier letter mass fills upper 75 percent; letters spread and interlock sideways with extended terminals, compact footer below; no miniature portrait centered in a wide canvas.

typography.main: Individually drawn tall irregular block capitals, thick slightly wobbly black outline, uneven counters and different widths. No conventional font layout.
typography.secondary: Hollow-outline quirky capitals for invitation, loose handwritten footer, small oval scribbled badge.

color_palette.base: Very light cool gray paper, approximate #e4e7e5; black contour and four to six pure bright color fills.
color_palette.variation: Different color assignment by theme, maintaining a lively warm/cool clash.

image_treatment.texture: Delicate fine neutral paper grain across very light cool-gray background and all uninked counters; subtle tonal variation, no coarse fibers, spots, gradients or vignette. Preserve existing local dry-ink marks and color strokes inside lettering. No yellow aging, shadows or gloss.

design_rules: Keep both main words complete and readable.
Draw uneven glyph anatomy and interlock neighboring rows.
Differentiate solid main text, hollow invitation and handwritten footer.
do: Keep vivid chromatic contrast and neutral paper.
Retain sparse localized scuffs visible in the reference.
avoid: Rigid grid or identical font glyphs.
Rounded inflatable 3D lettering or drop shadows.
Aged yellow paper and globally distressed texture.
negative_prompt: No watermark, source brand, rabbit, photographs, 3D extrusion, shadows, uniform typesetting, pastel wash, beige paper, confetti flood, missing letters or duplicated words.
prompt_template: Create a finished hand-drawn typography poster. The entire main headline reads exactly "{WORD_ONE} {WORD_TWO}" once, two words with no omissions or duplicates. This is a graphic poster whose giant letters themselves are the illustration. Rules: {STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS}. CORE overrides bounded FLEX. Draw every capital separately with thick organic black marker outlines, uneven narrow/tall or wide/bulging anatomy, oblique terminals and open counters. Exaggerate size differences. Letters press into each other and cross the boundary between the two tiers: stretch selected stems down and lift neighboring letters up, producing a tightly interlocked playful silhouette, NOT two neatly typeset rows. Keep every letter identifiable. Flat single-color fills using {PALETTE}. Very light cool gray paper background, approximately #e4e7e5, with matching paper inside every letter counter and hollow invitation. Tiny outlined oval badge above type reads "{BADGE}". Sparse surrounding doodles: {DOODLES}. Under the dominant letter mass, exact smaller hollow-outline hand-lettered invitation "{INVITATION}"; beneath that, exact casual black handwritten footer "{FOOTER}". Portrait: two dense tall interacting word tiers fill upper three quarters, footer underneath. Landscape: redraw a wide sprawling staggered two-tier mass filling most width and upper three quarters, smaller footer beneath; no portrait image pasted onto wide background. Subtle fine neutral grain, sparse dry-ink rub patches inside only a few colored glyphs, lightly irregular marker contour. Opaque light cool-gray paper with delicate fine even paper grain, no pure-white backdrop, aging tint, coarse fibers or global grunge. No shadows or dimensional materials. Exclude {SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID}. Generate as a 4K ultra-high-resolution raster image. Preserve the specified reference-style texture, edge character and intentional softness at their described scale, intensity and locations. Avoid artifacts that are absent from the intended style; do not automatically denoise, sharpen, polish or distress the image.
